aligned_event_associations.probability_definition: five-day-head probability at the exact day-minus-5 origin

timing_audit.last_predictor_relative_to_origin: origin-1 = 18 UTC on previous calendar day
timing_audit.comparison_boundary: same 00UTC cutoff; retrospective common-date reforecast benchmark, one IFS cycle
timing_audit.member_recovery_rule: 10 consecutive westerly days must occur within the 47-day trajectory and before 30 April

sampler_probability_audit.reason: Primary class-0 origins are sampled equally by event/lead, hard classes 1-3 are sampled uniformly from a combined pool, and background class 4 is sampled from a separate pool. Selection therefore depends on event and time-to-onset, not binary class alone for every cumulative horizon.
sampler_probability_audit.allowed_claim: direct probability-head outputs or prior-corrected risk scores evaluated with proper scores
sampler_probability_audit.forbidden_claim: scalar prior correction proves calibrated population onset probabilities

claim_boundary: Frozen retrospective rolling-refit diagnostics. No prospective leakage-free claim, calibrated-population-probability claim, causal state mechanism or operational superiority is established.
